notes.title: Issue with Radeon Cards fixed
notes.content:
Updated a new version of the game, fixing an issue found in some Radeon cards (Radeon RX480 for instance) 
There was an infinite loop in the library atioglxx.dll causing the game to hang. 

Thanks to Damien for the help and letting me floodfill his hard disk with log files!

notes.title: Last Hours Of Jack - the official guide
Last Hours Of Jack - the official guide
Major update of Last Hours Of Jack available!
notes.content:
Mouse and keyboard support added!
-----------------------------------------
For all users not having a gamepad controller, you can select the control type in the menu, via selecting 'View controls', 'Control Mode'.
You can choose between 'Mouse and keyboard' or 'Keyboard only'.
'Mouse and keyboard' allows you to orient jack with the mouse, as well as using the 3 mouse buttons to attack, interact, pick or throw weapons.
In 'Keyboard only' control, the ALT key has been remapped to the SPACE key.
Also, it is easier to trigger finisher under 'Keyboard only' mode: 3 wide attacks (with SHIFT) will launch a direct/finisher, instead of having to trigger it with CTRL+SHIFT.
Gamepad controls are still the same.

Also, minor bugs and issues have been fixed.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Last Hours Of Jack Update!
notes.content:
Hey fellas, a new version (1.01) of Last Hours Of Jack has been released with some bugfixes!

- Fixed an important issue with keyboard controls: sometimes arrow keys kept stuck!

- First time users will have unlimited framerate by default. Framerate was fixed at a maximum of 60 FPS the first time the game was launched. You can set the frame rate settings in Options->Graphics Options, limiting the FPS to 30, 60 or 'Adaptable' - this last option is the one that allows non-limited/fixed framerate.

- First-time-launch resolution detection: some computers have shown issues with the screen resolution the first time the game is launched. Now the game chooses the most appropiate resolution more wisely. You can still change the resolution in Options->Graphics Options and set your favourite screen one if you don't like the one the game has chosen for you.

- For players worried about getting dizzy with the combat camera, remember that you can disable it in Options->Gameplay options. This option was already available on version 1.00.

Thank you all!
